name: chenp-mods
description: Two Claude Code mods: a prompt upgrader and an automatic model picker.

plugins.name: prompt-upgrade
plugins.description: Turns a rough prompt into a great one in a pane: up to three quick questions, a rewrite, and a side-by-side review before anything runs.

plugins.name: auto-model
plugins.description: Picks the model and thinking effort for each turn from how hard your prompt looks.
